# Danny Phan

> Danny Phan is a security operations and automation engineer based in Hanoi, Vietnam. This site is his project hub.

## Projects

- [antiRea](https://antirea.dannyphan.me/): Open-source TypeScript library that meters dataset access per identity and flags coordinated bot abuse for web apps and SaaS. Server-side, zero dependencies, advisory only. Current release: 2.8.0, MIT license. npm: @dannyphan190/anti-rea.
- BaoAnSearch: Pharmaceutical product search and catalog tooling (internal tool).
- [Catopedia](https://catopedia.space/): Free bilingual cat encyclopedia in Vietnamese and English.
- News Translator: AI-curated news translation and automated publishing pipeline (AI curation, translation, Playwright posting).
